body:
`tests/unit/test_802_metadata_change_dispatch.py::test_enforcer_missing_log_logs_single_info_not_warning_spam`
fails on a clean `origin/main` checkout on this machine.

Confirmed unrelated to any in-flight branch: it fails identically with a feature
branch's changes stashed, and the file references nothing in the cover or
metadata-provider surface.

Notable because CI reports `main` green, so either the test is excluded from the
Fast Tests / Integration selection, or it depends on ambient state present
locally and absent in CI. Either way the local `tests/unit` run is not clean,
which erodes the signal a tick relies on when it runs the suite before merging.

Determine which of the two before assuming the test is simply wrong: a test that
passes in CI only because CI never runs it is a coverage gap, not a flake.
title: Pre-existing red: test_802 enforcer_missing_log fails locally while CI reports main green
